Home / Bulk Entry & Update Sheet
Dashboard

Bulk Entry & Update Sheet — Register and update, spreadsheet-style.

Not only can you paste like Excel to bulk-register new tasks — you can also bulk-update existing tasks found by due-date search, and download or import Excel files.

Paste like Excel to bulk-register

Just copy a range from a spreadsheet and paste it into the cells. Link parent/child tasks in bulk via row IDs, and speed up routine entry with row templates and CSV import

Search by due date to bulk-update existing tasks

Load existing tasks found by date range and assignee into the sheet, then push only the fields you actually changed to Backlog

Update conflicts are detected automatically

Checks whether someone else updated the same task after it was loaded. Choose to resolve it with either "Force Update" or "Reload Latest"

Excel file download and import supported

Columns like type and assignee stay real dropdowns even inside Excel. After editing, drag & drop the file onto the drop zone to import — nothing reaches Backlog until you confirm

Cut the effort of registering and updating alike.

No more registering or updating tasks one at a time — do it all at once, spreadsheet-style.
